description: This source file defines interfaces and implementations for managing units of work and transactions within a database context, specifically tailored for workflows, sessions, and change tracking in a system. It includes transaction management with retries, registration of changes, and methods for executing complex operations atomically.

classes.name: UnitOfWork
classes.description: Interface for a unit of work managing database changes atomically.

classes.name: WorkflowUnitOfWork
classes.description: Extended interface for workflow-specific operations within a unit of work.

classes.name: ChangeType
classes.description: Enumeration representing types of database changes: New, Dirty, Deleted.

classes.name: Change
classes.description: Struct representing a database change with associated metadata.

classes.name: unitOfWorkBackend
classes.description: Internal interface for backend-specific operations related to workflows and sessions.

classes.name: unitOfWorkImpl
classes.description: Concrete implementation of the UnitOfWork interface, managing transaction execution and change registration.

classes.name: workflowUnitOfWorkImpl
classes.description: Implementation of WorkflowUnitOfWork, providing workflow-specific transaction methods.

methods.name: RegisterNew
methods.description: Registers a new entity for insertion in the transaction.

methods.name: RegisterDirty
methods.description: Registers an existing entity to be updated.

methods.name: RegisterDeleted
methods.description: Registers an entity to be deleted.

methods.name: Commit
methods.description: Executes all registered changes atomically in a transaction, with retry logic for transient errors.

methods.name: Rollback
methods.description: Cancels all registered changes and rolls back the transaction.

methods.name: HasChanges
methods.description: Checks if there are pending registered changes.

methods.name: GetChangeCount
methods.description: Returns the number of pending changes.

methods.name: IsActive
methods.description: Returns whether the unit of work is still active.

methods.name: StoreWorkflowWithExecution
methods.description: Stores a workflow and its execution atomically within the unit of work.

methods.name: UpdateWorkflowStatus
methods.description: Updates the status of an existing workflow and optionally stores a new execution.

methods.name: CompleteWorkflowWithResults
methods.description: Marks a workflow as completed and stores results atomically.

methods.name: StoreWorkflowWithSession
methods.description: Stores a workflow and session atomically within the unit of work.
